strings.en: Kusuha: Thanks for all your hard work, everyone. Get some good rest, okay?
Bullet: There's a lot going on this time, so there's no way to clear it all in one go...
Kusuha: Hey, Bullet, how many hours a day do you play Super Robot Wars?
Bullet: Hmm... Just listening to the quit messages takes about four hours, I think...?
Kusuha: Huh, that's kind of amazing. You really play a lot.
Bullet: Nah, I'm nothing compared to Masaki.
Bullet: Plus, I hear he clears it fast enough to put Cybuster to shame.
Kusuha: Huh... Is that so.
Lüne: Finally taking a break? Then let's get some exercise, exercise! Come on, like those two over there!
Sänger: Brooklyn, join me for training.
Bullet: Yes, Major!
Sänger: Here we go! Ten thousand strikes!!
Bullet: Yes, sir!!
Lüne: ...Okay, that's a bit of an extreme example... But not getting enough exercise is bad for you.
Lüne: Come on, everybody, do 1,000 push-ups with me! Let's go!
Kuro: ...Lüne's got no room to talk about other people, meow.
Rio: ...I lost to Ryoto in simulator training again...
Ryoto: Y-You don't need to worry about it that much. That last set was looking pretty good...
Rio: Ugh... Ryoto, one more round!!
Ryoto: Whaaat!? But I thought we agreed on twenty sets...
Rio: Then this time... cooking! Yes, a cooking contest!!
Ryoto: Whaaaat!?
Rio: I'll never lose when it comes to cooking! It's decided! Let's go to the kitchen right now!!
Ryoto: Th-Then... how about a bread-baking contest instead?
Rio: Huh? Bread? Ryoto, you bake bread?
Ryoto: Y-Yeah. Well... lately, anyway.
Rio: Th-That's news to me...
Tasuku: Hey, Leona, you're Elzam's cousin, right?
Leona: Yes. What about it?
Tasuku: So how's the food he makes?
Leona: It's quite delicious, I'll have you know.
Tasuku: Then how come the food you make is so... you know?
Leona: I-I am making an effort.
Tasuku: Nahaha, so is that for my sake, by any chance?
Leona: ...I-I'll shoot you.
Shu: Oh, finished already? Then allow me to share a little piece of valuable information with you.
Shu: In truth, this time the game's difficulty changes depending on how many times you save while playing.
Shu: The more you timidly save, the harder later stages become... Heh... It's already too late for you.
Shu: I jest, of course... Heh heh heh...
Ryusei: Phew, done and done!
Aya: Heh, thanks for your hard work, everyone. Get some good rest, okay?
Ryusei: Oh yeah, you hear? Looks like we're gonna be in an anime!
Aya: What? Really!?
Ryusei: And it's a robot anime! Woo-hoo, awesome!
Aya: But all that shouting sounds like hard work.
Ryusei: What're you saying, Aya!? This means we might even get into the Super Robot Wars games!
Rai: ...We're already in them.
Ryusei: Huh? Rai... You were here?
Levi: Heh heh heh... Finished, are you? Then submit to my army or turn off the power here... Choose.
Shiro: You can't talk like that, meow. They won't play again next time, meow.
Levi: What...? Then what should I do?
Shiro: Hmm... Let's see, meow... For now, why not try copying me, meow?
Levi: Copy you...?
Levi: ...Finished, meow? Then join us, or turn off the power here... Choose... meow.
Shiro: ...Well, I guess that'll do, meow.
Lüne: ...Hey, Masaki. There's something I wanna talk about.
Masaki: Wh-What's with the serious tone?
Lüne: How long are we gonna stay like this?
Masaki: Huh? How long? What're you talking about?
Lüne: You know, like Kyosuke and Excellen... we should...
Masaki: We should...?
Lüne: Come up with a combo attack.
Masaki: A combo attack?
Lüne: Yeah. Like Cross Smasher plus Akashic Buster makes Akashic Smasher, or something.
Masaki: Hmm, let's see...
Irm: ...Seriously? You got my hopes up, and that's the punchline?
Radha: My, my, everyone seems tired. At times like this, yoga is just the thing...
Masaki: N-No way in hell! I'm outta here!
Kuro: Ah, Masaki!
Shiro: Where are you going, meow!?
Radha: ...Oh, well. Then I'll teach Kuro and Shiro some yoga instead.
Shiro: Y-Yoga...!?
Radha: That's right. The cat asana. See, like this...
Shiro: Fnyanyanyaaa!!
Radha: There, all done.
Shiro: ...Fnya? It didn't hurt at all, meow. It was totally normal.
Kuro: It's the cat asana... Of course it was, meow.
Eun: Captain, it seems this operation ends here.
Lefina: I see. Thank you for all your hard work, everyone.
Eun: C-Captain! What are you wearing...?!
Lefina: Huh? Well, the operation's over, so I thought I'd go to bed...
Eun: T-To bed...?
Sean: Hmm... Knowing you, Captain, I was quite certain you'd be the frilly type...
Lefina: I-Is this negligee no good...?
Sean: Not at all. The contrast has its own charm. A feast for the eyes, truly.
Eun: Um, XO... I don't think that's the part you should be commenting on.
Katina: What, it ends here? Boring.
Katina: Hey, Russel! Say something funny.
Russel: Wh-Why all of a sudden...?
Katina: If I don't laugh, you get a hundred lashes.
Russel: Ugh...! O-Okay, here goes.
Russel: ...I win this bout. Victory's mine, Ka-tina!
Russel: I-I knew it wouldn't work...
Katina: You bastard...! Since when am I YOURS?! Huh?!
Russel: Huh?! N-No, that's not what I meant!!
Gilliam: ...Hm? What's this?
Gilliam: Why am I in a place like this...?
Gilliam: Say a few words?
Gilliam: Hmm... Let me see...
Gilliam: Don't forget to check out Hero Senki too!
Gilliam: ...Wait, maybe I shouldn't have said that...
Albero: As captain of the Cry Wolves, I have something to tell you all.
Albero: A death may carry some meaning for others.
Albero: But to oneself, it is meaningless. There is nothing to be learned from your own death.
Albero: ...
Albero: That said, there are exceptions. Don't forget to save often during missions. ...That is all.
Gilliam: What? A few words here? As I said before, I'm not very good at this...
Gilliam: Very well. Here goes.
Gilliam: Ahem, please enjoy Super Hero Operations too... Wait, I wasn't even in that one.

Carla: Phew, all done, all done. Time for a coffee break!
Yuuki: Wrong. It's tea time.
Carla: Same difference. Anyway, break time!
Yuuki: ...Wait. What are you doing?
Carla: "Wait"? It's just what it looks like.
Carla: I'm making tea with a tea bag.
Yuuki: S-Stop that. If you're going to brew tea, follow the proper steps...
Carla: Oh, come on! If we do it your way, we'll be here all day.
Carla: Well then, everyone! See ya later!
Shine: So this is the end. But parting here is so lonely...
Shine: If you could, I'd be delighted if you played it straight through... I mean, all in one go...
Latune: Princess Shine, some people are busy and don't have the time...
Shine: Y-You're right. Then please, do have a good rest.
Latune: We hope to see you again.
Shine: And so, your hosts until now have been Shine Hausen and...!
Latune: ...L-Latune... Subota...
Shine: Latune, really! That's not how it goes, is it?! Please do it the way we rehearsed!
Latune: ...Y-Yes...
Shine: Now then, once more from the top!
Shine: ...Your hosts until now have been Shine Hausen and...!
Latune: Latune Subota!
Shine: And our motto is...!
Shine: Royal Fairyyy!
Latune: Royal Fairyyy!
Latune: ...S-So embarrassing...

Masaki: N-No way in hell! I'm outta here!
Kuro: Ah, Masaki!
Shiro: Where are you going, meow!?

Viletta: So the operation ends here. ...Good work.
Aya: Captain, please say a few words.
Viletta: .........
Viletta: I'll leave it to you, Aya.
Aya: Wh-What?! Ah! Hey! Where are you going, Captain?!
Sänger: So it ends here. Very well... Even a warrior needs rest.
Rätsel: Sänger, I've made coffee. Take a breather.
Sänger: Hm... I'll have some.
Sänger: Rätsel... This is...!
Rätsel: Just a few drops of brandy, and this happens...
Gilliam: Just as we predicted.
Kai: ...You two, quit teasing him.

Fiona: So that's the mission done. Raul, take care of the Excelano's maintenance, okay?
Raul: Hold it. What are you gonna do?
Fiona: I got all sweaty, so I'm going to hit the shower.
Raul: What are you talking about? You're helping too!
Fiona: I'm counting on you, big bro-ther!
Raul: Hey, get back here! Don't call me "big brother" only when it suits you!
Raji: ...I see, so the game ends here. How truly fascinating.
Mizuho: Huh? What's fascinating about it?
Raul: What's up?
Raji: Well, I thought I'd look into the shutdown sequence...
Raul: Look into it...?
Mizuho: You don't mean...
Raji: Yes. First, I'll take the hardware apart and...
Raul: Whoa! You can't do that!!
Mizuho: I'm so sorry! I'm so sorry!!
Raul: W-Well, see you next time! Hey, Raji! Get back here!!
Tsugumi: That's it for today's game... Ibis, want to go grab something to eat? It's on me today.
Ibis: Thanks, Tsugumi! Um... is it okay if one more person comes along? It's a guy, actually...
Tsugumi: Ibis inviting a guy? That's a first...! Sure. As a special treat, I'll cover him too.
Arado: Thanks for the grub, Chief Takakura!
Tsugumi: Wait, the guy coming with us is...?!
Ibis: Yep, Arado. We promised to have a contest to see who can eat the most cake.
Arado: I'm gonna do it! My goal's 30 slices!
Ibis: All right! I won't lose either! I'll break right through my limits!!
Tsugumi: B-Before that, I think my wallet's going to hit its limit...
Tsugumi: Princess Shine, I'm terribly sorry for such a forward request, but may I have a look at your dress...?
Shine: I've heard you're quite knowledgeable about fashion as well, Chief Takakura. If mine will do, please.
Tsugumi: Oh... These ribbons, these frills, this lace... A young girl's every dream is right here.
Latune: So you like frilly clothes like these, Chief Takakura.
Russel: ...I wonder if Lieutenant Katina would seem a bit more ladylike if she wore clothes like these...
Tsugumi: Hmm... I'm not sure, but if you tried to put her in one, she'd be furious, no question. See...?
Russel: L-Lieutenant?! Wh-What I just said, um...
Shine: Well then, let's leave Lieutenant Katina to Lieutenant Russel and have some tea.
Latune: Will Lieutenant Russel be all right...?
Shine: Say, Latune. During battle, I sometimes hear you shouting quite fiercely...
Latune: Th-That's...
Shine: What is it?
Latune: Well, um, that's...
Latune: Try playing around with the settings in Free Battle Mode...
Kota: Good work, everyone! Come watch me and the Compati Kaiser kick butt again, okay?
Roa: Kota... Use its proper name once in a while.
Kota: Like I said, "Compatible Kaiser" is way too long.
Roa: But you only dropped three letters.
Kota: So what? Want me to shorten your name too?
Roa: How?
Kota: Ugh... Drop three letters and there's nothing left.
Kota: Hey, Roa. What were you doing before you came to our world?
Roa: Dodgeball.
Kota: Huh?!
Roa: I played soccer and air-boarded too.
Kota: Wh-What?! Just who are you...?
Bullet: It's Brooklyn Luckfield's Impression Theater! Now, guess who I'm doing!
Bullet: Curse the misfortune of having met me.
Kusuha: Umm... I think that's...
Excellen: I know! It's Pretty Boy's big brother!
Bullet: Wrong! But close! Okay, here's another one.
Bullet: Hyzol Launcher, fire!
Rai: ...Amusing act. Do it again.
Bullet: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Lieutenant Raidiese!
Excellen: Oh, "close"... So that's what he meant.
Kusuha: Hey, Leona. Got a minute?
Leona: What is it?
Rio: Leona, you're going out with Tasuku, right?
Leona: And what level of "going out" do you mean?
Rio: Boyfriend and girlfriend, obviously!
Kusuha: Y-You don't have to make that face...
Rio: You like Tasuku, don't you?
Leona: Wha...?!
Rio: Come on, it's just us girls talking. Well?
Leona: Well... I suppose... I don't dislike him, I'll grant you.
Kusuha: That's a pretty vague answer...
Tasuku: And that's mission complete!
Leona: Good work.
Tasuku: Hey, hey, right now... it's just the two of us, right?
Leona: It is.
Tasuku: Then how about a hot kiss?
Leona: A-As if I could do something like that in a place like this! Idiot!!
Tasuku: Then where am I s'posed to do it?!
Eita: Good work! I'm Eita Nadaka!
Eita: I'm an operator for now, but I'm working hard to captain a Space Noah-class ship someday!
Eita: Huh? Which ship do I want to captain?
Eita: Let's see, if I could, the Hagane...
Daitetsu: ...I'm the Hagane's captain.
Eita: O-Of course, sir!
Eita: Then the Kurogane...
Tetsuya: I'm the Kurogane's captain... some of the time.
Eita: Then the Shirogane...
Lee: ...Greenhorn. A million years too early.
Eita: Th-Then which one CAN I have?!
Tetsuya: Hmm, let's see...
Daitetsu: ...The Megane. Your glasses.
Tetsuya: Oh! I see.
Eita: M-Megane?! What hull number is that supposed to be?!
Ouka: Looks like we're taking a break here. Seolla, why don't we have a bath while we can?
Seolla: Yes, Sister.
Ouka: Well then, let's go.
Arado: Man, I'm beat. Looks like there's time, so maybe I'll go grab a quick bath.
Seolla: Kyaaah! Mister Arado, you pervert!!
Arado: Huh?! Mister?! Why are you calling me Mister?!
Ibis: Done, done! Tsugumi, what's today's snack?
Tsugumi: Takakura-brand cheesecake, with orange sauce.
Ibis: Yay! I call dibs on half the cake!
Tsugumi: Sure. Once you finish the training regimen I put together.
Ibis: I'll do anything for cake!
Ibis: ...So, here's a proposal. If I do double the training, can I eat double the snacks?
Tsugumi: Heh, yes, yes. ...At this rate, I'm less a coach than a pet owner...
Ibis: Everyone watching, good luck with your studies and your work. See you later!
Tsugumi: Now, Ibis... once the game's over, it's training time.
Ibis: OK! Anti-G training, mental training, classroom work... I'll do anything!
Tsugumi: Nope. Today's lesson is this...
Ibis: Ugh, don't tell me...?!
Tsugumi: Let's limbo!! Now, as defending champion, let's aim for even greater heights...
Tsugumi: Or in this case, even lower ones!
Ibis: Ugh, ugh... Fine...
Tsugumi: Everyone watching, find your own strengths and work hard to develop them.
Tsugumi: And so, everyone...
Tsugumi: See you again!
Ibis: See you again!
Arado: Oh? Break time at last, huh?
Latune: I don't think we know if it's "at last"...
Arado: Right. They might've switched the power off by accident.
Seolla: Then they wouldn't get to see the quit message.
Arado: Huh? Is that how it works?
Seolla: Have you even read the manual?
Arado: Uh, um... Actually, I'm just winging it as I go...
Latune: I think you should read the manual carefully before you play...
Arado: Y-Yeah, yeah...
Seolla: That's all for now from Seolla Schweizer and...
Latune: Latune Subbota...
Arado: And Arado Balanga!
Seolla: See you next time!
Arado: Bye-bye!
Latune: Bye-bye!
Seolla: .!!
Arado: Huh? Not "G Again"?
Lamia: Ending already... It's no concern of mine. Do as you please.
Axel: Heh... You don't really mean to end it like that?
Axel: ...Just a doll after all, W17. Can't even give a proper sign-off, this one.
Lamia: ...Captain. Understood, I'll try.
Lamia: And so, ladies and gentlemanses, the day is most auspiciously fine.
Lamia: I too am being sad about farewells, or kinda sorta doing so, or not doing so, so it is.
Lamia: Therefore, I most humbly beseech the continuing again soon-like, if you would be so pleasing!
Lamia: ...That is all.
Axel: ...My mistake. Just talk normally.
Lamia: Understood. ...Until next time, play as you see fit.
Lamia: That's a promise between Lamia Loveless and you...!
Axel: Hm? Hey, aren't you going a little haywire again?
Excellen: Oh, done? Then, Kyosuke, just like we rehearsed!
Kyosuke: .........
Kyosuke: Roar, Revolving Staaaake! And behold! A raging storm of romance...!
Kyosuke: Next time on Super Robot Taisen OG!! My Alt slices through the skies of love and sorrow!
Kyosuke: See you in hell, my friend...
Axel: ...Beowulf. Since when were you that kind of character?
Kyosuke: ...Tasuku cleaned me out at cards. I'm broke.
Axel: What? ...I'm not following.
Excellen: Simply put, I'm lending him money, but lending it for nothing would be no fun, right?
Axel: I get it. You lend it if he does as you say... that's the deal, is it?
Excellen: That's the idea.
Excellen: Come on, no interrupting! Kyosuke, take it from the top!
Kyosuke: Roar, Revolving Staaaake!
Axel: ...Pay off that debt before the next session, Beowulf.
Alchemie: A little rest... I see. Then, everyone, I bid you good day.
Excellen: That's kinda plain, Alchemie. You need a little more, y'know, trendy flair.
Alchemie: Trendy...?
Alchemie: Understood. I shall... give it my very best.
Kyosuke: Wait. Don't "understood" me. What are you planning?
Alchemie: First, in front of everyone, I'm all lovey-dovey with Kyosuke.
Kyosuke: ...What?
Alchemie: But... when we're alone, I treat him terribly cruelly and coldly, you see?
Excellen: Wow, totally different in public and in private! That's our Alchemie! So on top of the trends!
Alchemie: I have been doing my studies properly.
Kyosuke: ...I don't know much about it, but shouldn't that be the other way around?
